bio.text: Mike Lee was elected to the U.S. Senate from Utah in 2010.
He graduated from Brigham Young University and from its law school in 1997, then clerked for Judge Dee Benson and for Judge Samuel Alito on the Third Circuit.
Lee worked as an attorney at Sidley & Austin, as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, and as general counsel to Gov. Jon Huntsman.
